appliesTo: Story-level work items before sprint commitment

rules.name: User story format
rules.check: description starts with 'As a' and contains 'I want' and 'so that'
rules.fix: Rewrite as: As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>.

rules.name: Acceptance criteria
rules.fix: Add at least two testable acceptance criteria.

rules.name: Estimated and small enough
rules.check: storyPoints is set and between 1 and 8
rules.fix: Estimate, or split stories above 8 points.

rules.name: Dependencies resolved
rules.fix: Resolve the dependency or move the story to a later sprint.

rules.name: Design attached for UI work
rules.check: if hasUi is true, designLink is set
